INFERENCE: the level is small relative to the operating cash flow that produces it, because capital spending consumes most of it \u2014 so the forensic question is less \"is the numerator inflated\" than \"is the capex deduction complete\".\n\nFour mechanisms answer that question in the same direction. FACT [10-Q Leases]: \"Non-cash acquisitions of right-of-use assets Finance leases | 1,247 | 758\" and \"Cash flows used for financing activities \u2013 Finance leases 218 | 99\". FACT [10-Q AP note]: \"Property, plant, and equipment | 4,370 | 2,925\". INFERENCE (from both): productive assets are entering the balance sheet through a channel that never touches PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, and a growing share of the capex that does touch it has not yet been paid. Both raise FCFF relative to the economics.\n\nTwo working-capital mechanisms run the same way, in mirror form to how they are usually framed. FACT [10-Q Receivables]: \"Trade receivables | $5,492 | $5,419\". FACT [MD&A]: \"Total revenue for the first nine months of 2025 increased 50%\". FACT [Cash Flows]: \"Receivables | (123) | (2,562)\" and \"Inventories | 148 | (125)\". INFERENCE: receivables did not grow faster than revenue and inventory did not grow faster than cost of sales \u2014 the opposite happened, releasing cash into operating cash flow on a comparison that a further step-up in shipments would not repeat.\n\nWhat I do not find. FACT [E-07 ca.buyback]: \"No shares were repurchased in the first nine months of 2025\"; FACT [E-10]: diluted shares rose to 1,125 from 1,123. FACT [E-07]: ca.acquisition and ca.divestiture both not_found; goodwill \"1,150 | 1,150\". FACT [E-04]: \"no non-GAAP measure is presented\". INFERENCE: mechanisms 2, 4 and 10 are absent on evidence, not merely unproven \u2014 there is no shrinking base, no asset-sale gain, and no shift of cost from expense to capitalisation in the disclosed periods.\n\nTwo mechanisms I cannot resolve, and say so rather than hedge. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE \u2014 needed: income-statement composition for the quarter ended 2024-08-29, which is inside D-02's TTM window; why: the bundle gives that quarter as a single operating-cash-flow figure with no breakdown; would_change: a discrete cash gain there would make mechanism 3 present, its absence would make it absent. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE \u2014 needed: the E-09 provision and reserve roll-forward; why: FACT [declared absent inputs] \"E-09 was SKIPPED after five truncated runs (DX-96)\"; would_change: a reserve release inside the window would make mechanism 5 present; a flat reserve balance would make it absent.\n\nDefinitional caveat the reader should apply before using the number at all: the company publishes no free-cash-flow definition, and D-02's is unlevered FCFF, which adds back after-tax interest, deducts share-based compensation, and deducts gross capex while management frames capital spending \"net of proceeds from government incentives\" of $1,294m over nine months.\n\nThe single observation that would move me from \"the present mechanisms plausibly account for most of the level\" to \"they are immaterial to it\" is a period-matched schedule for the four quarters ending 2024-08-29 through 2025-05-29 showing finance-lease equipment additions and the change in property-plant-and-equipment payables to be small in those quarters, with the $1,247m of finance-lease additions and the payable build concentrated outside the window.\n\nASSUMPTION: I treat mechanisms 7 and 8 as flattering in mirror form \u2014 a working-capital release rather than a build \u2014 because the metric under examination is cash rather than earnings; a reader who reads those two items literally as stated would mark both absent, and nothing else in this answer depends on that choice."}
